- Quiet period / publicity: we need a 45-day quiet period after go-live before any press release or joint announcement.
- Logo use / reference rights: we need explicit permission to use Redwood’s logo in our partner page and in a joint case study; we prefer a simple attribution "Partner: Redwood Inference" and a 90-day approval window for quoted metrics.

Karthik / Tom / Kimberly —

Thanks — I reviewed Harvest’s redline and propose the following compromise language (summary here; full redline attached as legal_redline_MSA.pdf):

1) Quiet period: 30 days post-go-live is our standard; however, we can agree to 45 days for joint public-facing press releases if Harvest requires it, provided that Redwood retains the right to publish a controlled product announcement without customer-identifying details (e.g., "new integration available") after 30 days.

2) Logo / reference rights: we accept a limited license to use Redwood’s logo on Harvest’s partner page and included in a co-authored case study, subject to:
   - Prior written approval of any joint press release or case study that uses customer-identifying metrics. 
   - A 7-business-day approval window for marketing materials (extended only by mutual written agreement).
   - Use of the approved Redwood partner badge (attached) with colors and clearspace preserved.

3) Confidentiality carveout for regressions: any post-launch case study or benchmark that includes model performance metrics must include a statement about observed timeframe and dataset limitations; we will require a review cycle to avoid inadvertent leakage of private data.

Please see attached legal_redline_MSA.pdf for inline edits. If Harvest wants the 45-day quiet period as an absolute requirement, that is negotiable but we will need a limited exception so Redwood can run product announcements referencing the integration in non-identifying terms after 30 days.

I’ve attached our proposed redline and included alternate phrasing for Section 7 (Publicity) and Section 9 (Confidentiality).

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: legal_redline_MSA.pdf (pdf, 112KB)

All —

Quick marketing take: the logo use and badge approach Laura suggested is fine from a brand perspective. A few operational asks so Harvest can rely on us post-signature: 

- Redwoods to provide high-res PNG/SVG and a partner badge kit within 5 business days of executed order form.
- Attribution line we prefer: "Powered by Redwood Inference" (this ensures consistent phrasing across partner pages). If Harvest needs "Partner: Redwood Inference" we can accept, but prefer our phrasing.
- Approval windows: 7 business days is tight for coordinated press — if Harvest asks for 45-day quiet period we ask that any joint press be scheduled with at least 15 business days' notice to allow design/PR review.

Marissa — can you confirm whether we want to include a short brand-use appendix in the Order Form (one paragraph + link to badge kit) or keep it as an internal deliverable? If it stays internal we risk mismatched expectations.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park

Karthik / team —

Appreciate the quick turn. Harvest is generally comfortable with Laura’s proposed language. A couple of small asks from our side:

- We would prefer the 45-day quiet period to be the default for joint press releases (Harvest is in a regulated space and needs the extra runway for internal reviews).
- We can accept the 7-business-day approval window for most marketing collateral, but for any materials that include customer metrics we ask for the full 90-day approval window you proposed earlier in this thread.

If Redwood can sign off on 45 days for joint press releases and keep the 7-business-day window for partner page/logo usage, Harvest will proceed to circulate for signature. Otherwise we’re likely to need one more short approval cycle.
